# Repository-wide Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) **before suggesting or making changes**.

This is a shared, project-neutral namespace/schema registry. Do not modify another project's subtree; do not self-reserve project slugs or edit the central registry. Published URI/version paths are permanent. No custom GitHub Actions workflows, broad formatting, speculative schema publication, or unsupported standards claims. For scoped work require a named project owner, exact version path and validation evidence.
